description: This file contains unit tests for decoding different types of frames in the GatewayFrame protocol, including event frames, request frames with nested parameters, and unknown frames, verifying proper deserialization and raw data preservation.

classes.name: GatewayFrameDecodeTests

methods.name: decodes event frame with any codable payload
